site.title: CoMeBench

sections.heading: Why CoMeBench
paragraphs: **CoMeBench** is a benchmark for …. It provides a unified, reproducible evaluation protocol so that results across papers are directly comparable, and it ships with a public dataset, evaluation scripts and a maintained leaderboard.

Write two or three sentences on the gap you are filling: what existing benchmarks miss, and what CoMeBench does differently. Keep it concrete — a number or a concrete failure mode of prior work reads far better than an adjective.
Every task is language-conditioned, and the whole suite can be run locally in under an hour on a single GPU.

items.title: Controlled difficulty
items.text: Each task varies one factor at a time, so a score drop can be attributed to a specific capability instead of being an average over confounded settings.

items.title: Automatic scoring
items.text: Every instance has a programmatic checker, so evaluation needs no human judges and runs identically on any machine.

items.title: Held-out split
items.text: A hidden test split guards against overfitting to the public leaderboard, with a submission server for blind evaluation.

sections.heading: Run it in four steps
sections.code:
# 1. get the code
git clone https://github.com/<org>/CoMeBench
cd CoMeBench

# 2. install dependencies
pip install -e .

# 3. download the data
python scripts/download.py --root ./data

# 4. evaluate your model
python eval.py --model your-model --split test
